notes: Lika now runs on Windows too.
A timeline can come in a part at a time: Lika shows its clips and asks which, picked by hand or by the timeline's markers, tracks and labels.
From inside DaVinci Resolve and Premiere Pro: scripts and a panel hand a timeline to Lika, and the match or the finished clips go back (in Lika: Editors, at the bottom of the side panel).
A CapCut project can be added as it is.
A new set starts on Neutral, with Shoulder 100, Mids 30, Warmth 20 and Saturation 100, a finer Fine grain and ProRes 422 HQ.
The parade starts on the full range and has a Highlights range.
